tup.description: sequence of arrays The arrays must have the same shape along all but the third axis. 1-D or 2-D arrays must have the same shape.
constraints: tup's elements must be at least 1-D and up to 2-D arrays

output.description: ------- ndarray The array formed by stacking the given arrays, will be at least 3-D.

constraints: Input arrays' third axis lengths must match
